description: This header file declares functions for memory-efficient forward and backward passes of customized attention kernels used within the PyTorch ROCm backend, specifically for transformer models. It includes tensor parameters, optional parameters, and namespace scope, indicating its role in declaring an interface for kernel implementations.

methods.name: mem_eff_forward_ck
methods.description: Performs memory-efficient forward pass of attention kernel, returning tensors such as output, q, k, v, lse, seed, offset, and dropout random values.

methods.name: mem_eff_backward_ck
methods.description: Performs backward pass computations for attention kernels, returning gradients with respect to q, k, v, and bias.
